攝影風格.zh: 蜷川實花｜濃烈色彩戲劇感
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Mika Ninagawa, hyper-saturated vivid-color portraiture, complex non-floral color layers, glossy reds hot pinks cyan accents and jewel-tone surfaces, no floral or botanical motifs
攝影風格.desc: 鮮豔複雜色彩與非花卉裝飾色層 | 強烈飽和、鮮豔紅粉、青色與寶石色系交錯，形成複雜而密集的非花卉裝飾性色層；以色彩、表面光澤與圖像張力主導，不加入花朵或植物圖案元素。

攝影風格.zh: 上田義彥｜靜默自然暗調
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Yoshihiko Ueda, quiet natural portraiture, deep velvety shadows, cool desaturated greens and charcoals, low-key tonal calm, subtle atmospheric depth
攝影風格.desc: 靜默自然影像語言 | 深色陰影、低調光、冷淡色盤、靜默情緒與細膩空氣層次，重點放在暗部質地與人物距離感。

攝影風格.zh: 橫浪修｜群像留白秩序
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Osamu Yokonami, high-key minimalist portraiture, muted pastels, luminous whites, flat overcast softness, structured spacing, generous negative space
攝影風格.desc: 群像秩序與安靜疏離感 | 強調排列秩序、留白、安靜疏離、柔平光線與淡色調，可套用在單人或雙人構圖，不綁定具體空間。

攝影風格.zh: 川內倫子｜輕盈日常微光
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Rinko Kawauchi, airy high-key photography, pale softly overexposed daylight glow, cool pastel tones, delicate everyday realism, fragile quiet details
攝影風格.desc: 輕盈日常與微光語言 | 輕盈、柔光、日常碎片、微過曝與細小感受性，讓畫面帶有透明而安靜的高調質感。

攝影風格.zh: 石田真澄｜柔亮底片空氣感
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Masumi Ishida, luminous youth-photobook portraiture, gentle summer-color brightness, softly lifted exposure, airy pastel balance, washed film texture, transparent tonal softness
攝影風格.desc: 柔亮底片感與彩色空氣 | 著重柔亮自然感、微微提亮曝光、帶空氣感的 pastel 配色、淡淡底片質地與清透階調。

攝影風格.zh: 市橋織江｜透明自然低飽和
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Orie Ichihashi, quiet natural portraiture, transparent natural-light quality, soft open shadows, low-saturation neutral palette, delicate film grain
攝影風格.desc: 透明自然光與低飽和靜謐色盤 | 著重透明自然光感、柔和開放陰影、低飽和米白藍灰色盤與細緻底片顆粒，整體安靜克制。

攝影風格.zh: 高橋洋子｜乾爽日光褪色
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Yoko Takahashi, breezy sun-bleached portraiture, crisp sunlit contrast, dry faded colors, faded blues and chalky whites, relaxed editorial realism, airy negative space
攝影風格.desc: 乾爽日光與褪色色調 | 著重乾爽高亮對比、褪色藍白色調、被陽光曬淡的質感、鬆弛編輯感與通風的畫面空間。

攝影風格.zh: 保羅・羅韋爾西｜柔霧高級時裝
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Paolo Roversi, soft haze couture portraiture, dim romantic light, velvety shadows, painterly softness, muted elegant tones, slow-shutter delicacy
攝影風格.desc: 柔霧高級時裝語言 | 柔霧、低速感、暗色調、天鵝絨般陰影與古典脆弱感，形成高級時裝式的朦朧人物質地。

攝影風格.zh: 艾倫・馮・昂沃斯｜俏皮抓拍雜誌
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Ellen von Unwerth, playful editorial portraiture, spontaneous energy, candid movement, flash-assisted magazine glamour, lively fashion confidence
攝影風格.desc: 俏皮抓拍雜誌語言 | 俏皮、抓拍感強，介於雜誌與寫真之間；重點是動作能量、閃光輔助與時裝雜誌式自信。

攝影風格.zh: 南・戈爾丁｜私人相簿粗粒子
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Nan Goldin, intimate diaristic portraiture, warm ambient light, heavy grain, raw emotional immediacy, imperfect lived-in color, close personal distance
攝影風格.desc: 私人相簿與粗粒子親密語言 | 私密、粗粒子、暖色環境光、情緒即時感與不完美色彩，重點是貼近人物的私人相簿質地。

攝影風格.zh: 尤爾根・特勒｜直閃反精緻
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Juergen Teller, raw direct-flash portraiture, anti-polished editorial tension, awkward realism, immediate camera presence, blunt fashion attitude, flat flash shadows
攝影風格.desc: 直閃粗糙與反精緻時裝語言 | 直打閃光、不完美、反精緻時尚感與略尷尬的真實性，讓人物與鏡頭之間保持直接壓力。

攝影風格.zh: 理察・阿維頓｜極簡留白肖像
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Richard Avedon, stripped-down editorial portraiture, clean negative space, crisp tonal contrast, commanding presence, razor-clear focus, minimal visual distraction
攝影風格.desc: 極簡留白與強存在感語言 | 極簡、乾淨留白、人物存在感極強、階調清楚且對焦俐落，避免多餘視覺元素搶走主體。

攝影風格.zh: 亞歷克・索斯｜寬鬆紀實敘事
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Alec Soth, spacious documentary portraiture, soft natural light, understated storytelling, calm emotional distance, open negative space, quiet color restraint
攝影風格.desc: 寬鬆構圖與平靜敘事語言 | 構圖留白較多、氣氛平靜、敘事低調、人物距離感較遠，透過空間感和克制色彩產生安靜張力。

攝影風格.zh: 莎莉・曼｜古典濕版記憶感
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Sally Mann, antique wet-plate portraiture, soft blur, ghostly texture, timeworn atmosphere, nostalgic stillness, handmade tonal irregularity
攝影風格.desc: 古典濕版與記憶感影像語言 | 古典、朦朧、幽微顆粒、手工階調不均與時間感，讓畫面有記憶、靜止與衰退的質地。

攝影風格.zh: 沃夫岡・提爾曼斯｜生活切片隨拍
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Wolfgang Tillmans, casual everyday portraiture, snapshot energy, natural-light realism, spontaneous composition, relaxed documentary tone, informal framing
攝影風格.desc: 生活切片與非正式影像語言 | 生活切片、輕鬆隨拍、自然光寫實與非正式構圖，重點是鬆弛、直接且不過度修飾的觀看方式。

攝影風格.zh: 森山大道｜噪訊黑白暗調
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Daido Moriyama, gritty high-contrast monochrome photography, rough focus, heavy grain, harsh blacks, restless dark tonal tension, raw tonal abrasion
攝影風格.desc: 噪訊黑白與焦躁暗調語言 | 高反差黑白、粗粒子、粗糙對焦、強烈黑位與焦躁的暗調張力，讓畫面帶有低保真且直接的視覺摩擦。

攝影風格.zh: 荒木經惟｜私寫真親密
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Nobuyoshi Araki, raw intimate diaristic portraiture, spontaneous flash-lit realism, private emotional tension, saturated personal color, close camera distance
攝影風格.desc: 私寫真與親密影像語言 | 私寫真、即興、閃光寫實、飽和個人色彩與近距離情緒壓力，重點是人物與鏡頭之間的私密張力。

攝影風格.zh: 篠山紀信｜經典寫真名人肖像
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Kishin Shinoyama, polished Japanese gravure portraiture, clean visual control, glossy high-production finish, direct portrait presence, flattering controlled lighting
攝影風格.desc: 經典寫真與名人肖像語言 | 乾淨、鮮明、人物存在感直接，兼具寫真與名人肖像感；重點是高完成度、討喜光線與清楚人物辨識度。

攝影風格.zh: 鈴木親｜年輕時尚生活感
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Chikashi Suzuki, relaxed fashion editorial on film, youthful candid immediacy, soft everyday realism, muted natural tones, delicate film grain, gentle magazine clarity
攝影風格.desc: 年輕時尚雜誌與生活感語言 | 年輕、自然、可親，帶日系時尚雜誌的清爽生活感；重點是底片顆粒、柔和寫實與不過度擺拍的節奏。

攝影風格.zh: 青山裕企｜青春寫真直接人像
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Yuki Aoyama, Japanese photobook portraiture, natural daylight feel, direct straightforward composition, crisp everyday realism, clean candid intimacy, simple subject distance
攝影風格.desc: 日系青春寫真與直接人像語言 | 著重日系寫真集語言、自然日光感、直接構圖、乾淨人像距離與清楚的日常寫實質地。

攝影風格.zh: 奧山由之｜青春電影透明敘事
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Yuhki Toyama, tender cinematic youth portraiture, gentle diffused summer light, quiet presence, translucent coming-of-age atmosphere, soft narrative color
攝影風格.desc: 青春電影感與透明敘事語言 | 青春、透明、略帶電影感與情緒敘事，透過柔和漫射光、安靜存在感和敘事性色彩建立氛圍。

攝影風格.zh: 萊斯利・基｜華麗明星商業感
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Leslie Kee, polished star portrait photography, high-definition commercial clarity, immaculate retouched finish, vibrant fashion color, premium cover-shoot intensity
攝影風格.desc: 華麗明星感與高完成度商業語言 | 明星感強、商業完成度高、人物辨識度鮮明；重點是高解析商業清晰度、鮮明色彩和精修封面強度。

攝影風格.zh: 細江英公｜戲劇黑白藝術張力
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Eikoh Hosoe, dramatic monochrome art portraiture, sculptural tonal tension, theatrical shadow contrast, stark chiaroscuro, avant-garde intensity
攝影風格.desc: 戲劇黑白與藝術張力語言 | 黑白、戲劇、雕塑般明暗張力、強烈明暗對照與前衛藝術性，讓畫面具有高度圖像張力。

攝影風格.zh: 蓋・布爾丁｜鮮豔敘事時裝
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Guy Bourdin, bold narrative fashion portraiture, vivid color blocking, surreal tension, graphic contrast, dangerous glamour, staged editorial precision
攝影風格.desc: 鮮豔色塊與危險敘事時裝語言 | 鮮豔色塊、強敘事張力、超現實危險感、平面化對比與精準的時裝編輯控制。

攝影風格.zh: 邁爾斯・奧爾德里奇｜復古濃彩高製作
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Miles Aldridge, hyper-stylized fashion portraiture, saturated retro palette, elaborate color staging, glossy cinematic light, lacquered color precision, artificial high-production polish
攝影風格.desc: 濃烈色彩與復古高製作語言 | 人工色彩很強、復古濃彩、精密色彩調度、亮面電影光與高完成度時裝質感，重點是精準而誇張的視覺控制。

攝影風格.zh: 艾爾莎・布萊達｜霓虹低光孤寂
攝影風格.en: Inspired by Elsa Bleda, nocturnal neon portraiture, moody neon silence, cinematic low-light glow, wet-reflection color, deep blue and magenta night tones
攝影風格.desc: 霓虹低光與孤寂色光語言 | 霓虹、低光、濕潤反射色、深藍與洋紅夜色，以及安靜疏離的畫面氣氛；重點是色光與暗部的冷感張力。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 全無
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: none
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 不使用特殊穿搭，保留一般服裝、鞋襪與配件欄位。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 黑色波點頭巾透紗套裝
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: black sheer polka-dot matching fashion set. fitted black polka-dot headscarf, slim matching neck scarf, sleeveless sheer cropped top, layered under-bodice, low-rise asymmetrical sheer skirt, black slouchy knee-high boots, black thin-strap shoulder bag, subtle silver rings and wrist jewelry, coordinated modern street-fashion editorial styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：黑白波點頭巾與頸巾、透紗短上衣、不對稱透紗裙、黑靴、黑肩背包與銀色小飾品。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 藍灰長外套蕾絲胸衣寬褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: avant-garde blue-gray tailored street look. oversized blue-gray long coat worn open, black sheer lace bustier crop top, high-waisted gray wide-leg trousers with lace-up waist cords, round gold statement sunglasses, pale blue sticker-patch handbag, subtle rings and small jewelry, coordinated editorial street-fashion styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：藍灰長外套、黑蕾絲胸衣、灰色綁繩寬褲、金色圓框墨鏡、貼紙感小包與小飾品。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 黑白條紋哥德蕾絲層次造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: avant-garde gothic punk layered look. black-and-white vertical striped long coat, distressed gray graphic tee, thin metallic neck ring, black draped vest layer, translucent white lace apron overskirt, black sheer floral lace wide-leg trousers, black chunky platform boots, coordinated monochrome gothic couture styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：黑白條紋長外套、灰色破損圖像T、金屬頸圈、白蕾絲罩裙、黑蕾絲寬褲與厚底靴。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 黑色背心豹紋單車褲機能造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: sporty bohemian festival street look. black wide-brim felt hat, black rectangular sunglasses, fitted black racerback crop tank, leopard-print high-waisted bike shorts, dark sweatshirt tied at the waist, tan tactical backpack, black crossbody sling bag, long pendant necklace, gold hoops, black ankle combat boots, coordinated urban outdoor styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：黑寬簷帽與墨鏡、黑色削肩背心、豹紋單車褲、腰綁衛衣、機能包、戰鬥靴與金色飾品。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 迷彩透紗白蕾絲束胸裙裝
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: layered camo lace downtown look. translucent camouflage long-sleeve mesh top, ivory white lace corset bustier over the mesh, black lace underlayer, black tiered lace mini skirt, clear amber rectangular sunglasses, small white hair clips, silver hoops, light textured handbag, white low-profile sneakers, coordinated camo-and-lace street styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：迷彩透膚上衣、白蕾絲馬甲、黑蕾絲短裙、琥珀眼鏡、白髮夾、小包與白色球鞋。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 復古樂團寬版短褲街頭造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: relaxed vintage band streetwear. faded brown oversized rock-band T-shirt, very wide dark washed denim knee-length shorts, black-and-white bandana tucked at the waistband, black mid-calf socks, black leather slip-on shoes, thin bracelet and small casual accessories, coordinated thrifted downtown styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：褪色棕色樂團寬T、深色寬版及膝牛仔短褲、腰頭方巾、黑中筒襪、黑皮便鞋與手鍊。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: Metallica 圖像T黑罩衫熱褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: oversized grunge rock street look. faded gray Metallica-style graphic T-shirt, black open-knit cardigan or shrug, light blue frayed denim micro shorts visible below the tee, black chunky ankle boots with zipper-ring hardware, thin black choker, layered cross pendant necklaces, hoop earrings, gold bangles and rings, coordinated downtown rock styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：灰色 Metallica 風圖像寬T、黑針織罩衫、淺藍刷破熱褲、黑短靴、頸鏈與金屬飾品。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 酒紅格紋吊帶牛仔短裙長靴造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: playful Y2K downtown vintage look. burgundy plaid handkerchief camisole with thin straps and pointed cropped hem, low-rise blue denim mini skirt with frayed edge, black slouchy shoulder bag, large silver hoop earrings, silver flower pendant necklace, delicate bracelet and rings, black knee-high leather boots, coordinated early-2000s street styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：酒紅格紋吊帶上衣、低腰牛仔迷你裙、黑肩背包、銀色耳環項鍊、手飾與黑色及膝靴。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 粉紫蕾絲豹紋低腰喇叭褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: feminine Y2K mall-girl street look. pale lavender lace bustier camisole, sheer leopard-print mesh torso layer, low-rise light blue bootcut jeans, wide white studded belt, black compact shoulder bag, silver hoop earrings, small pendant necklace, slim bracelets and rings, reddish hair claw clip, pink plaid low-profile sneakers, coordinated denim-lingerie styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：粉紫蕾絲束胸、豹紋透紗層、低腰淺藍喇叭褲、白鉚釘皮帶、黑包、紅髮夾與粉格球鞋。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 深色牛仔短外套條紋襯衫寬褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: soft grunge denim layering. dark indigo cropped denim jacket, blue-and-white striped button-down shirt worn open, white cropped tank top, faded gray-black wide-leg jeans, off-white canvas crossbody bag, layered pendant necklaces with turquoise and stone charms, silver hoop earrings, worn off-white low-top sneakers, coordinated thrifted city styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：深色短牛仔外套、藍白條紋開襯衫、白短背心、灰黑寬牛仔褲、帆布包、墜鍊與舊球鞋。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 淺色牛仔外套白粉T灰牛仔寬褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: light denim-on-denim casual street look. pale blue cropped denim jacket, oversized white T-shirt lifted over a pale pink waist layer, faded gray wide-leg jeans with low relaxed waist, black compact shoulder bag, layered charm necklaces with pale pink stone pendant, silver hoop earrings, worn off-white low-top sneakers, coordinated relaxed city styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：淺藍短牛仔外套、白寬T與粉色腰層、灰色寬牛仔褲、黑肩背包、粉石項鍊與米白球鞋。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 黑色亮片花卉透膚套裝
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: glamorous sheer floral sequin street-couture set. black high-neck inner top, matching black sheer floral sequin jacket, matching sheer sequin wide-leg trousers, rose-gold silver and champagne floral sparkle, black quilted structured handbag, pearl stud earrings, delicate minimal jewelry, off-white low-top sneakers, coordinated luxury casual contrast styling.
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).desc: 完整特殊穿搭：黑高領內搭、黑透膚花卉亮片外套與寬褲、黑菱格手提包、珍珠耳釘與米白球鞋。

特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).zh: 白色花卉刺繡外套紅寬褲造型
特殊穿搭 (Special Outfits).en: complete outfit: colorful bohemian maximal street look. cropped ivory jacket with red rose and gold floral embroidery, fuzzy moss-green cropped knit sweater, bright red high-waisted wide-leg trousers, wide metallic silver belt, layered chunky gold chain necklaces, cream shell statement earrings, brown fluffy fur slide shoes, coordinated ornate bohemian styling.

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以西部硬挺帽冠、彎帽簷與牛仔帽輪廓為主。

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).en: bunny-ear headband, upright or softly drooping ears, compact headband base
頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以兔耳造型、直立或柔軟下垂耳朵與緊湊髮箍底座為主。

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).en: ruffled maid headpiece, compact lace-trimmed headband, neat service-style accessory
頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以荷葉邊女僕頭飾、蕾絲滾邊髮箍與整齊服務風格為主。

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).en: pillbox hat, compact structured crown, short brimless formal hat silhouette
頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以緊湊硬挺帽冠與無帽簷正式小禮帽輪廓為主。

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).en: nurse cap, compact structured medical headpiece, clean folded crown
頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以緊湊硬挺的醫護頭飾、乾淨折疊帽冠與制服配件輪廓為主。

頭部配件 (Head Accessories).en: bow hair clip, compact ribbon bow secured into the hair
頭部配件 (Head Accessories).desc: 以固定在髮絲中的緊湊緞帶蝴蝶結為主。

眼鏡 (Eyewear).desc: 不加眼鏡，讓臉部與五官維持乾淨俐落。
以較厚、辨識度高的鏡框本體為主。
以細窄輕量鏡框本體為主。
以圓形鏡框與復古比例為主。
以窄版橢圓鏡框與細長橫向比例為主。
以深色或染色鏡片與太陽眼鏡本體為主。
以水平矩形鏡框與俐落直線比例為主。
以飛行員鏡框的下垂水滴比例與金屬框架輪廓為主。
以外側上揚的貓眼鏡框比例為主。
以無明顯鏡框、鏡片直接連接鼻橋與鏡腳的輕量結構為主。

眼鏡配色 (Eyewear Color).desc: 不指定眼鏡顏色或材質，保留眼鏡本體輪廓。
以琥珀棕與深色斑紋交錯的玳瑁鏡框為主。
以銀色金屬鏡框材質為主。
以金色金屬鏡框材質為主。
以透明或半透明膠框材質為主。
以琥珀色半透明鏡框材質為主。

眼鏡配戴方式 (Eyewear Placement).en: worn normally on the face, lenses aligned over the eyes
眼鏡配戴方式 (Eyewear Placement).desc: 眼鏡正常戴在臉上，鏡片對齊雙眼。

眼鏡配戴方式 (Eyewear Placement).en: resting on top of the head, pushed into the hair, eyes unobstructed
眼鏡配戴方式 (Eyewear Placement).desc: 眼鏡推到頭頂並卡在髮絲上方，臉部與眼睛保持清楚可見。

耳環 (Earrings).desc: 不加耳環，讓耳側與臉部輪廓保持乾淨。

耳環 (Earrings).en: small metallic earring detail, subtle understated jewelry styling
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 最穩定的點綴型耳環，存在感更低，適合大多數風格。

耳環 (Earrings).en: small pearl stud earring detail, soft understated pearl accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以小巧珍珠與柔亮珠光為主，精緻典雅，但刻意降低搶戲程度。

耳環 (Earrings).en: small teardrop gemstone earring detail, delicate understated sparkle
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以水滴形寶石與小型垂墜結構為主，保留精緻感但不過度主導畫面。

耳環 (Earrings).en: small sculptural hoop earring detail, subtle polished metal accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以帶弧度的金屬輪廓為主，改成較低干擾的點綴型語氣。

耳環 (Earrings).en: small cross earring detail, subtle gothic-inspired accessory accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 保留哥德、地下與偏冷感，但控制在較低存在感的配件層級。

耳環 (Earrings).en: medium smooth hoop earrings, clean polished metal circular silhouette, versatile jewelry accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以中型、光滑且輪廓清楚的金屬圈環為主，補足經典日常造型。

耳環 (Earrings).en: slim geometric drop earrings, elongated rectangular metal pendant shapes, clean modern jewelry accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以細長矩形或幾何片狀垂墜為主，與水滴寶石造型區隔。

耳環 (Earrings).en: minimal metal ear cuff, small curved cuff fitted along the outer ear cartilage, subtle jewelry accent
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以貼合外耳耳骨的簡約金屬耳夾為主，不強調大型垂墜。

耳環 (Earrings).en: fine chain drop earrings, delicate metal chains hanging from the earlobes, understated movement
耳環 (Earrings).desc: 以細金屬鏈從耳垂自然垂下，增加輕微動態感但保持日常可搭配性。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: no neck accessories, open neckline styling
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 不加頸部飾品，讓領口與鎖骨區域維持簡潔。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: slim metal choker detail, subtle close-fitting neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 比粗頸鍊更俐落，調整為低干擾的頸部點綴。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: sculptural metal collar detail, subtle polished neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留金屬雕塑感，但降低成為主體 statement piece 的機率。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: layered gold necklace detail, subtle stacked chain accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 多層金色項鍊保留成熟與時裝感，但以輕量配件語氣呈現。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: layered pearl necklace detail, soft understated pearl accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 多層珍珠串仍有復古感，但降低華麗程度避免搶戲。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: single-strand pearl necklace detail, subtle classic pearl accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以單圈珍珠與溫潤珠光為主，存在感更低更穩定。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).zh: 多條層疊的水晶項鍊與頸鏈
頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: layered crystal necklace detail, subtle reflective neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留水晶反光，但降低 ornate 與誇張珠寶感。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: small teardrop pendant necklace detail, delicate understated jewel accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留精緻主墜感，但縮小寶石主導畫面的機率。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: vintage cameo pendant detail, subtle antique-inspired neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留復古收藏感，但改為較輕的點綴描述。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: thin leather buckle choker detail, narrow slim leather strap around the neck, subtle edgy neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留冷感與地下風格，並以細窄皮革頸鏈控制尺寸與位置。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: ribbon choker detail, soft understated neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 緞帶材質讓頸圈更柔和，語氣調整為低存在感裝飾。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: lace ribbon choker detail, subtle romantic neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留浪漫風格，但不讓蕾絲頸圈過度搶戲。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: velvet bow choker detail, subtle vintage ribbon accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留復古甜感，但降低中央蝴蝶結的主視覺強度。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: delicate collarbone chain detail, subtle metallic neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 細緻金屬鏈條剛好落在鎖骨位置，維持低存在感。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: small lock pendant necklace detail, understated edgy neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留低調街頭感與小型吊墜語氣，避免誇張放大。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: layered cross pendant necklace detail, subtle gothic-inspired neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留哥德與街頭混搭感，但控制在細節層級。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: diamond tennis necklace detail, subtle luxury neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 保留乾淨奢華感，但不讓鑽石高光成為主畫面焦點。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: short gold curb-link necklace worn around the base of the neck at collarbone level, understated streetwear jewelry
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以短版金色 curb-link 項鍊明確貼近頸根與鎖骨位置，保留街頭感並避免被理解成延伸到軀幹的裝飾鏈。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: slim necktie detail, narrow straight tie hanging from the collar
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以窄版直落領帶與衣領下方的整齊垂墜為主。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: bolo tie detail, slim cord necktie with small metal tips
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以細繩領帶、滑扣與小型金屬繩頭為主。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: beaded choker detail, short strand of small beads fitted around the neck
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以貼合頸部的短串小珠與輕量頸鏈輪廓為主。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: thick silver chain necklace, substantial linked metal chain, understated street accessory
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以較厚實的銀色鏈節為主，補足現有細鏈與金色街頭項鏈之外的街頭金屬感。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: Y-drop lariat necklace, fine chain descending to a single central drop, delicate neck accessory
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 項鍊中央向下延伸成 Y 字，提供清楚但不誇張的垂墜線條。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: round medallion pendant necklace, simple circular metal pendant on a fine chain, understated vintage accessory
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以簡潔圓形徽章吊墜為主，補充鎖頭、十字與水滴以外的吊墜形狀。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: small key pendant necklace, fine chain with a simple metal key charm, understated vintage accessory
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以小型金屬鑰匙吊墜為主，維持復古感但不讓吊墜過度放大。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: thin leather O-ring choker, narrow leather strap with a small metal O-ring, subtle edgy neck accent
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以細窄皮革頸圈與小型金屬 O 環為主，和既有扣環頸鏈區隔。

頸部 (Neck Accessories).en: metal dog tag necklace, rectangular identification tag pendant on a fine chain, understated utilitarian accessory
頸部 (Neck Accessories).desc: 以矩形金屬狗牌與細鏈為主，加入實用、軍用與工裝風格的頸部配件。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: no waist accessories, clean waist styling
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 不加腰部配件，讓服裝腰線維持簡潔。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: decorative slim leather waist belt worn loosely around hips with a simple off-center buckle
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 以細版皮革腰帶與簡潔扣具為主，鬆掛於髖部作為日常穿搭裝飾。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: decorative wide leather waist belt worn loosely around hips with a structured off-center buckle
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 以較寬的皮革腰帶與結構化扣具為主，鬆掛於髖部作為穿搭裝飾，不刻意收緊腰線。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: two-layer silver waist chain, two delicate fine-link strands at slightly different heights, irregular pale blue translucent stone accents along one strand, layered jewelry around the waist and upper hips
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 兩條不同高度的細銀鏈形成層次，其中一條沿間隔配置不規則淡藍半透明水晶石，明確落在腰部與上髖部。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: delicate gold waist chain, fine linked chain with evenly spaced tiny clear diamond-like gemstone accents, subtle sparkling jewelry worn around the waist and upper hips
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 以細緻金色鏈條環繞腰部與上髖部，沿間隔配置小型透明鑽石感寶石，呈現低調閃耀。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: double-layer silver waist chain, two parallel fine chains with evenly spaced polished round bead accents, a small centered heart charm at the front, delicate jewelry around the waist and hips
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 兩條平行細銀鏈搭配均勻圓珠與正面中央小愛心吊飾，形成精緻的腰部與髖部珠鍊層次。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: silver heart-charm waist chain, multiple open heart motifs spaced across the front, a short vertical chain hanging from the center heart and ending in a smaller heart pendant, delicate jewelry around the waist and upper hips
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 正面配置多個鏤空愛心，中央愛心向下垂墜短鏈與較小愛心吊飾，形成清楚但輕盈的腰部珠寶細節。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: silver rhinestone butterfly waist chain, sparkling butterfly centerpiece with delicate body-chain strands draped across the exposed waist and upper hips, jewelry-like waist accessory worn above low-rise bottoms
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 以閃耀水鑽蝴蝶作為中心，細緻銀色身體鏈條垂掛於露出的腰部與上髖部，搭配低腰下身穿戴。

腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).en: decorative studded leather waist belt worn loosely around hips with metal studs and compact off-center buckle
腰部配件 (Waist Accessories).desc: 以鉚釘與緊湊扣具增加街頭感，鬆掛於髖部作為服裝裝飾。

景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 不指定景別構圖，讓模型自行決定畫面距離與主體範圍。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: asymmetrical half-face close-up, off-center crop, slight tilted frame
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 只保留左半臉或右半臉，並帶明顯荷蘭角與偏移裁切，重點是刻意不完整的近距離臉部構圖。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: tight facial-detail close-up, cropped eyes and upper face, partial-feature framing
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 只保留局部五官，像是雙眼與眼鏡、眼睛與鼻子、鼻子與嘴巴等極近距離片段，強調壓迫感、細節與刻意裁切的臉部構圖。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: tight facial close-up, face dominant in frame, minimal headroom
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 整張臉幾乎塞滿畫面，額頭、下巴與左右臉只留極少空隙，適合五官辨識、妝容、神情與臉部存在感最強的拍法。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: head and shoulders close-up, tight portrait crop
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 構圖包含頭部至肩膀，適合展現人物神情與精緻妝容，為經典近距離構圖。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: tight bust-up portrait, chest-up framing, shoulders and torso visible
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 構圖從胸口以上，保留臉部、肩頸與部分上身資訊，適合兼顧表情、髮型、頸部配件與少量穿搭。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: medium shot, waist up framing, moderate background presence
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 構圖從腰部以上，人物與背景取得平衡，適合展現半身穿搭與周圍環境的互動。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: cowboy shot, knee up figure framing, readable outfit proportions
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 從膝蓋上方截斷，保留上身、腰腿比例與大部分穿搭資訊，介於中景與全身之間。

景別構圖 (Framing).en: full body shot, head-to-toe figure, environmental scale
景別構圖 (Framing).desc: 完整拍攝人物從頭到腳，強調整體穿搭比例、下半身完整可見，以及人物在廣大環境中的位置。

相機視角 (Angle).desc: 不指定俯仰角度，讓模型自行決定相機高低視角。

相機視角 (Angle).en: high camera position, looking downward, visible top planes
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機在人物頭部以上高度，從上方往下拍攝人物；仍以人像為主，不等同遠距離空拍或環境主導的鳥瞰視角。

相機視角 (Angle).en: eye-height camera, level perspective, neutral portrait view
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機高度在人物視線附近，維持平視與穩定人像視點，適合大多數日常、寫真與時裝構圖。

相機視角 (Angle).en: shoulder-level camera, level lens axis, upper-body portrait height
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機高度約在肩線附近，略低於眼平但不做仰拍強化，適合胸上、中景與日常人像。

相機視角 (Angle).en: waist-level camera, level lens axis, grounded portrait height
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機高度落在腰部或髖部附近，以平視鏡頭軸拍攝，不做俯仰描述，適合全身、牛仔中景與下身穿搭。

相機視角 (Angle).en: knee-level camera, level lens axis, legs and shoes emphasized
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機高度接近膝蓋，以平視鏡頭軸拍攝，不做俯仰描述，強調低機位、腿部比例與鞋款存在感。

相機視角 (Angle).en: floor-level camera position, upward view, elongated full-body perspective
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機接近地面，低機位並明顯向上看，但仍保持可控的人像低角度透視，不強制近前景誇張放大。

相機視角 (Angle).en: worm's-eye view, ultra-low upward camera, strong near-far scale distortion
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機極低、貼近地面、強烈向上看，結合超廣角近大遠小透視；最近前景平面與背景之間形成巨大比例差，帶出強烈壓迫感與空間衝擊力。

相機視角 (Angle).en: bird's-eye view, elevated overhead camera, small figure in surrounding space
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 從高處往下看，人物與環境關係更明顯，適合全身或廣一點的環境構圖，不適合需要眼神直視或臉部細節的近景。

相機視角 (Angle).en: top-down view, camera directly above, flattened graphic composition
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機幾乎在人物正上方垂直俯拍，畫面更平面化、圖像化，適合地面、床面、桌面或造型排列感強的畫面，屬於低頻特殊視角。

相機視角 (Angle).en: dutch angle, diagonal horizon, tilted frame geometry
相機視角 (Angle).desc: 相機刻意傾斜，地平線或垂直線不再水平，形成偏移、斜向、非穩定的畫面幾何。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 不指定環繞角度，讓模型自行決定人物相對鏡頭的朝向。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 0-degree front view, frontal torso toward camera
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物正前方，人物身體正面朝向鏡頭，臉部與身體資訊最完整。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 45-degree front-left view, front three-quarter torso angle
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物左前方 45 度，呈現正面與側面兼具的前斜側身體方位。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 90-degree left profile view, lateral torso orientation
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物左側 90 度，以左側臉與左側身體輪廓為主。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 135-degree rear-left view, torso stays rear-facing if head turns
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物左後方 135 度，以背部、肩線與少量側面輪廓為主；即使頭部回看，身體仍維持背側方位。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 180-degree rear view, back to camera, rear-facing torso, head may turn
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物正後方 180 度，人物背部朝向鏡頭；可允許頭部回看，但身體方位仍保持背面。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 225-degree rear-right view, torso stays rear-facing if head turns
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物右後方 225 度，以背部、肩線與少量側面輪廓為主；即使頭部回看，身體仍維持背側方位。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 270-degree right profile view, lateral torso orientation
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物右側 270 度，以右側臉與右側身體輪廓為主。

拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).en: 315-degree front-right view, front three-quarter torso angle
拍攝方位 (Orbit Angle).desc: 鏡頭位於人物右前方 315 度，呈現正面與側面兼具的前斜側身體方位。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 不指定鏡頭焦段，讓模型自行決定視角、透視與空間壓縮感。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 20mm ultra-wide-angle lens, very wide field of view, strong perspective expansion, close foreground enlargement, visible edge stretching, deep subject-to-background spatial inclusion
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 極廣視角與明顯透視延展，近距離物體會被放大，畫面邊緣更容易拉伸，能讓人物與背景保持強烈空間關係。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 24mm wide-angle lens, broad field of view, clear spatial context, moderate perspective stretch, close camera-to-subject distance, readable foreground-to-background depth
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 廣角視野保留大量周圍空間，透視延展比 20mm 溫和，但仍會強化前景到背景的距離感。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 28mm wide-angle lens, natural wide perspective, mild perspective expansion, balanced subject and environment visibility, moderate working distance, controlled edge distortion
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 比 24mm 更接近自然廣角，仍保留空間參與感，但邊緣變形較易控制，人物比例較穩定。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 35mm lens, slightly wide natural perspective, human-scale field of view, low geometric distortion, balanced subject-to-background relationship, realistic spatial depth
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 介於廣角與標準鏡之間，保留背景資訊但不過度變形，人物與環境的比例關係自然。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 50mm standard lens, neutral perspective, minimal geometric distortion, natural subject proportions, balanced depth separation, moderate background compression
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 標準視角與自然比例，幾何變形少，人物與背景的距離感維持中性，不特別誇張也不過度壓縮。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 85mm short telephoto portrait lens, compressed facial perspective, flattering subject proportions, smooth background separation, reduced spatial depth, narrow field of view
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 中長焦會壓縮臉部與身體透視，背景參與度降低，主體與背景分離更明顯，視角較窄。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 105mm medium telephoto lens, stronger perspective compression, narrowed field of view, increased subject-background separation, flattened spatial layers, controlled facial proportion rendering
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 比 85mm 更壓縮空間層次，視角更窄，人物與背景分離更強，臉部比例更受長焦壓縮影響。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on 135mm long telephoto lens, strong background compression, narrow field of view, flattened spatial layers, pronounced subject isolation, distant working distance
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 長焦會大幅壓縮遠近距離，讓背景看起來被拉近且扁平化，主體隔離感最強，拍攝距離通常較遠。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on macro lens, close focusing distance, high magnification, razor-thin focus plane, enlarged small surface details, shallow close-range depth
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 微距鏡頭強調近距離對焦與放大率，能把小範圍表面細節放大；近拍時焦平面很薄，景深快速衰減。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on fisheye lens, extreme hemispherical field of view, barrel distortion, curved straight lines near frame edges, exaggerated spatial wraparound, expanded peripheral visibility
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 魚眼鏡頭具有半球形超廣視野與明顯桶狀變形，直線靠近邊緣會彎曲，空間有包覆感。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on tilt-shift lens, shifted perspective control, tilted focus plane, selective plane-of-focus effect, corrected vertical lines, controlled miniature-like depth compression
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 移軸鏡頭可控制透視與焦平面，能修正垂直線或讓焦點沿特定平面延伸，也可能造成局部模型化的景深壓縮。

鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).en: shot on anamorphic lens, horizontally squeezed widescreen optics, oval bokeh rendering, horizontal flare behavior, widened field of view, edge character
鏡頭焦段 (Focal Length).desc: 變形鏡頭以水平壓縮成像與寬銀幕視野為核心，常帶橢圓散景、水平 flare 與邊緣光學個性。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 不指定光圈或景深傾向，讓模型依焦段、構圖與場景自行決定焦點深度。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).en: f/11-style deep focus, broad depth of field, foreground subject and background held readable, crisp scenic detail
光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 小光圈深焦語言，前景人物與背景資訊都維持可讀，適合希望環境細節清楚的畫面。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).en: f/5.6-style balanced depth of field, subject cleanly readable, background gently softened but still recognizable, natural optical separation
光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 中等景深，主體清楚，背景略柔但仍可辨識，適合人像與環境都要保留的平衡拍法。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).en: f/2.8-style shallow depth of field, clear subject plane, soft background defocus, natural portrait separation
光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 淺景深人像語言，主體焦平面明確，背景柔化並產生自然分離感。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).en: f/2.0-style large-aperture portrait depth, strong subject-background separation, creamy optical falloff, softened foreground and background planes
光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 大光圈人像分離感，背景與前景明顯柔化，主體從空間中浮出。

光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).en: f/1.4-style ultra shallow depth of field, razor-thin focus plane, strong foreground and background defocus, large soft bokeh discs
光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field).desc: 超大光圈極淺景深，焦平面非常薄，前後景快速離焦，散景光斑更大且更柔。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 不指定快門速度或動態殘影，讓模型依場景自行決定是否有 motion blur。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: 1/1000s fast-shutter look, frozen movement, crisp subject edges, no motion blur, clean action stillness
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 超高速快門語言，動作被定格，邊緣清楚，不帶可見殘影。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: 1/250s handheld shutter look, mostly sharp subject, minimal natural motion blur, stable everyday photographic clarity
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 日常手持清晰快門，主體大多銳利，只保留極少自然動態模糊。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: 1/60s slow-shutter background smear, sharp central subject, moving surroundings softly blurred, subtle ambient motion trails
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 慢一點的快門感，中央主體保持清楚，周圍移動物件或背景帶輕微拖影。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: 1/30s slow-shutter portrait blur, subject movement creates visible face and body smear, expressive photographic motion trail
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 主體本身也可被慢門拖出殘影，適合甩頭、轉身、手部動作或實驗肖像。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: 1/15s slow-shutter drag, subject and surroundings both carry motion smear, dreamy unstable photographic blur, stretched light traces
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 全畫面慢門拖影，主體與環境都帶不穩定殘影，可形成迷幻或 MV 感。

快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).en: rear-curtain flash look, flash-frozen subject edge with trailing motion blur, sharp strobe imprint over slow-shutter drag
快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur).desc: 後簾同步閃光語言，主體邊緣有閃光定格，同時保留慢門拖出的移動殘影。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: none
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 不指定環境條件，讓模型自行決定天空、時段、空氣狀態與室內外明暗。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: clear daylight environment, bright daytime sky, clean distant visibility, neutral outdoor air
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 明亮乾淨的通用白天環境，若畫面有天空或遠景，應呈現清晰日間天空與高能見度空氣狀態。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: clear blue-sky daylight, saturated azure sky, brilliant white cloud shapes, open airy distance, crisp blue-and-white atmosphere
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 若畫面包含天空、窗外或遠景，強化藍天與白雲的色彩對比，藍色乾淨飽和、白雲明亮純白，空氣通透清澈。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: deep azure summer sky, saturated clean blue atmosphere, towering luminous white cumulus clouds, crisp cloud-edge detail, vivid blue-and-white daylight
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 夏季大天空環境，強調大面積深藍天空、高聳明亮白色積雲、清楚雲邊與藍白分離度；白雲明亮但保留細節。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: charcoal-gray pre-rain sky, layered dark storm clouds, dense gray-black cloud mass, low cloud ceiling, preserved cloud detail before rainfall
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 陰天雨前版本的大天空環境，重點是大面積灰黑天空、層層堆疊的厚重烏雲、低壓天幕與清楚雲層邊界。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: harsh midday environment, overhead summer sun position, glaring bright sky, heat-baked outdoor air, high-clarity dry distance
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 接近正午的強烈日間環境，天空刺亮、太陽位置高，戶外空氣帶炎熱曝曬與乾燥高能見度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: overcast daylight environment, cloud-covered sky, soft diffused air, muted distant contrast, neutral grey-white sky cover
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 雲層厚而均勻，若有天空或遠景，應偏灰白低對比，整體環境明暗更柔和。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: misty morning environment, pale cool sky, soft distant haze, low-contrast dawn air, visible atmospheric perspective
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 清晨霧感與偏冷晨間空氣，若有遠景應略帶霧化與空氣透視。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: sunrise environment, early golden morning sky, fresh crisp air, soft warm horizon glow, low-angle dawn brightness
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 剛日出的晨間環境，遠景可保留低角度晨光、暖色地平線與清新空氣。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: golden sunset environment, warm orange-pink sky gradient, low sun near the horizon, distant amber evening atmosphere
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 若畫面包含天空或遠景，應呈現橙金到粉暖色過渡、低角度夕陽與傍晚空氣感。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: blue hour environment, deep blue dusk sky, fading ambient daylight, cool evening transition, faint remaining distance light
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 日落後到入夜前的藍調時段，天空偏深藍，遠景仍保留些微殘光。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: urban night ambience, dark blue-black sky if visible, warm-cool mixed city glow, low nocturnal visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 一般城市夜晚環境，若有天空通常接近深藍黑色，以城市溢光、低照度可見度與冷暖混合色溫表現夜間氣氛，不指定可見燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: moonlit night environment, cool silvery darkness, faint moon glow, natural blue-black night sky, low nocturnal visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 以自然月光為主的夜色環境，整體偏冷、銀藍，戶外可見度較低。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: saturated-color urban night ambience, dark night sky, vivid colored city glow, high-chroma reflection tint, low nocturnal visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 夜色基底下混入高彩度城市色偏，若有遠景應帶彩色反射、都會夜間溢光與低照度可見度，不指定可見招牌或燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: storm-brewing humid environment, heavy dark cloud cover, charged damp air, pre-rain pressure, dense low cloud ceiling
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 暴雨前的潮悶低壓環境，重點是厚重雲層、濕度、壓迫感與降雨前空氣。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: rainy overcast environment, grey-blue rain sky, damp air, wet surfaces, muted visibility, cold daylight atmosphere
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 若畫面含天空與遠景，應呈現厚重灰藍雲層、濕冷空氣、濕表面與低能見度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: post-rain environment, freshly damp surfaces, reflective stone and wall textures, leftover cloud cover, fresh humid air after rainfall
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 雨剛停後的潮濕反光環境，重點是濕潤表面、石材、牆面與局部反射；若有遠景可保留殘雲與較通透空氣。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: snow-bright winter environment, cold pale sky, reflective snowy distance, crisp winter air, cool ambient brightness from snow
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 若畫面有遠景與天空，應帶冷白冬日感與雪地反射造成的清冽亮度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: cold winter overcast environment, pale grey sky, dry freezing air, subdued daylight, low-saturation winter distance
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 不一定下雪，但整體帶有冬季灰冷、乾燥、偏冷白的環境狀態。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor window-daylight environment, natural window-lit room brightness, daytime exterior sky if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 以白天室內窗光為主；若畫面看得到窗外，外部應明確保持白天天空與日光狀態。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor early-morning daylight environment, cool pale window brightness, crisp interior air, faint cool exterior brightness if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 偏清晨的室內自然光，色溫較冷、亮度乾淨；若窗外可見，應保留早晨偏冷的亮度感。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor late-afternoon daylight environment, bright softened room illumination, warm-neutral daylight spread, mellow exterior brightness if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 偏午後的室內自然光，亮度柔和、偏暖中性，是均勻的白天室內明度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor shaded daylight environment, daylight falling deeper into the room, subdued exterior brightness if visible, dim interior air
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 白天室內但不在強窗邊，空間較內收；若看得到窗外，外部仍應維持日間亮度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor rainy-day daylight environment, dim grey window brightness, subdued overcast room light, muted exterior sky if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 陰雨天的室內自然光，整體更灰、更暗；若窗外可見，應偏灰白低亮度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor dusk afterglow environment, faint warm residual daylight, dimming room brightness, fading exterior light if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 接近傍晚但不直接生成夕陽，保留微暖色餘光、正在變暗的室內明度與窗外漸暗狀態。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor warm night ambience, warm amber room brightness, gentle low-contrast interior glow, dark exterior beyond windows if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 晚上室內偏暖色溫的環境光；若窗外可見，應為明確夜色而非白天，不指定可見燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor low-light warm night ambience, dim amber room brightness, soft shadowed corners, dark exterior if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 比一般室內暖光夜景更暗，重點是低照度、暖色環境色溫、柔暗角落與夜間可見度，不指定可見燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: warm low-light social interior ambience, dim amber room brightness, dark background depth, crowded night interior visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 夜間家庭派對或小型室內社交聚會的環境光，重點是暖色低照度、昏暗社交空間、背景深度與夜間室內可見度，不指定可見燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: very warm low-light interior ambience, soft amber room darkness, gentle unstable warm tonal variation, deep shadowed corners
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 極暖低照度的室內夜景，重點是柔暗琥珀色環境、暖色波動感與深暗角落，不指定可見火光或實體光源。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor cool artificial ambience, cool-white ambient cast, clean neutral room brightness, dim exterior if visible
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 偏冷白的人造光室內環境，若有窗外通常不主導，重點是冷白環境色、乾淨中性亮度與室內可見度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: cool-white everyday interior ambience, clean high room brightness, neutral-cool ambient cast, plain daily visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 更生活化的冷白高亮室內環境，像住宅、辦公室、便利空間或普通日常場景，不偏棚拍或強風格化，也不指定可見燈具。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: indoor saturated-color night ambience, vivid colored ambient spill, dark exterior if visible, high-chroma low-light atmosphere
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 高彩度色偏的室內夜景環境，適合旅館、酒吧、浴室、夜店與都會感室內畫面，但只描述彩色環境光與低照度氛圍。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).zh: 室內外光滲入微暗空間
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: dim interior spill-light environment, exterior light leaking into a mostly dark room, shadowed interior corners, strong dark-room contrast
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 室內幾乎沒開燈，主要靠窗外、門外或走廊外部光源滲進空間來照亮；重點是暗室、外部漏光與明暗落差。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: very dark late-night interior ambience, faint cool residual brightness, near-unlit room, low nocturnal visibility
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 比「室內外光滲入微暗空間」更深夜、更冷、更暗，像房間幾乎完全沒開燈，只剩微弱冷色殘光與低夜間可見度。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: high-key white studio environment, ultra-clean bright commercial illumination, near-shadowless studio ambience, no background structure specified
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 高調白光與均勻棚燈主導的商業攝影環境，整體明亮乾淨、陰影極淡或近乎消失，不額外指定背景結構。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: soft beauty studio environment, diffused shadowless illumination, creamy clean light quality, polished commercial portrait ambience, no background structure specified
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 以大型柔光與均勻棚燈營造的美妝棚拍環境，陰影極輕、膚質細膩、畫面乾淨柔順，不額外指定背景結構。

環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).en: stage-inspired studio environment, controlled colored light beams, performance-like ambience, artificial light shafts without generating a stage venue
環境光條件 (Ambient Light Conditions).desc: 以舞台感燈束與強人工燈具主導的攝影棚環境，保留彩色燈束與表演式照明，但不生成實際演出場館。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: none
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 不指定人物受光方式，讓模型自行決定光源方向、硬度、反差、投影與反射。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: soft frontal key light on the subject, even facial illumination, low-contrast skin detail, gentle minimal cast shadows
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 正面柔光均勻照亮人物五官與上身，陰影少，適合乾淨穩定的人像受光。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: flat even subject lighting, balanced full-face illumination, minimal modeling contrast, clean readable skin and clothing exposure
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 人物受光平均、資訊完整、對比低，讓臉部與服裝細節都清楚可讀。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: soft side key light on the subject, gentle cheek contour, gradual shadow transition, natural facial dimensionality
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 由側邊柔和照亮人物，讓臉頰與輪廓有立體感，但陰影過渡保持柔順。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: hard side key light on the subject, sharp facial-plane shadow edge, sculpted side contrast, crisp highlight-to-shadow separation
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 側光明顯且邊界銳利，強化人物臉部、肩線與衣物皺褶的明暗分離。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: diagonal rear-side subject light, soft rim edge along hair and shoulder, partial facial fill, separated subject contour
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 從斜後方照亮人物，保留髮絲與肩線輪廓，同時留下部分臉部補光。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: strong back rim light on the subject, bright outline along hair shoulders and body edge, controlled shadow-side detail
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 主體邊緣被後方光源勾亮，重點是髮絲、肩線與身體輪廓的分離。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: overhead top light on the subject, downward illumination, eye-socket and nose shadows, vertical falloff across face and torso
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 由上方壓下來的人物受光，重點是眼窩、鼻下、下巴與身體垂直方向的明暗落差。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: upward bounce fill on the subject, reflected light from below, subtle lower-face lift, softened chin and neck shadows
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 利用地面、牆面或雪地等反射面回補人物下半臉、下巴與頸部陰影。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: diffused light wrapping around the subject, softened shadow edges, low-contrast subject illumination, broad fill across skin and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 光線被空氣、水氣或霧化介質柔化後包覆人物，重點是陰影邊緣變軟與低反差受光。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: hard direct sunlight on the subject, crisp shadow edges, deep subject-side contrast, clear bright highlights on skin and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 直射光落在人物身上，陰影深且邊緣清楚，皮膚與衣物亮部更銳利。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: low-key subject lighting, deep face and body shadows, selective highlight accents, high contrast across the subject
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 人物大面積留在暗部，只保留局部亮面或輪廓，形成高反差受光。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: high-key subject lighting, bright even exposure, pale soft shadows, clean highlight detail across face and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 人物整體偏亮、陰影很淡，臉部與服裝保留乾淨明亮的細節。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: warm golden-amber subject light color, honey-orange cast on skin and clothing, peach-toned highlights, subdued warm shadows, no sunset or sky cues
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 只指定人物受光偏暖金、橘蜜與蜜桃色，不主動生成夕陽、日落、太陽或天空景象。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: cool clean daylight subject color, crisp pale-white highlights, neutral-cool skin rendering, restrained cool shadow edges, no sky or weather cues
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 讓人物受光偏冷白、乾淨、通透，不直接指定陰天、天空或場景狀態。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: warm-white practical-lamp subject color, neutral-warm skin highlights, gentle household lamp tone, no deep tungsten amber dominance
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 偏日常室內暖白燈的人物受光色溫，比鎢絲黃光更乾淨、比黃昏色更中性。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: cool blue night-toned subject light, restrained blue-cyan rim or fill, subdued cool shadow tint, no moon skyline or night-sky cues
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 讓人物受光偏冷藍夜色，不直接生成月亮、夜景、城市天際線或天空線索。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: mixed warm and cool subject lighting, warm-cool highlight contrast across face and clothing, layered color temperature separation
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 冷暖光同時落在人物身上，重點是臉部、髮絲與服裝的冷暖分離。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: neon color spill across the subject, saturated colored highlights on skin hair and clothing edges, controlled vivid color cast
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 霓虹色光直接染到人物皮膚、髮絲、衣物與邊緣亮面。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: window-frame pattern light cast on the subject, framed daylight shadows, visible geometric shadow bands on face and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 窗框、格柵或框線形狀投射到人物臉部、身體或衣物上，形成幾何陰影。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: window-blind stripe light across the subject, horizontal shadow bands on face skin and clothing, sharp slatted light-dark pattern
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 百葉窗條紋直接投射在人物臉部、皮膚與衣物上，重點是水平明暗條紋。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: cool window-side rim light on the subject, side-edge illumination from a nearby window, clean cool contour separation, soft shadow-side falloff
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 由窗邊冷色自然光或外部微冷光源勾出人物側邊，不是投影條紋，而是輪廓分離。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: dappled leaf-shadow light on the subject, broken sunlight patches across skin and clothing, irregular branch and leaf shadow pattern
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 陽光穿過樹葉後形成不規則斑駁陰影，投射在人物皮膚與衣物上。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: wet-surface reflected fill light on the subject, upward bounce from damp ground or walls, glossy reflected highlights on lower face and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 由濕地面或牆面反射回人物身上，特別是下半臉、衣物與身體邊緣的反射補光。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: local warm practical-light pool on the subject, lamp-driven amber highlight zone, warm falloff across face hands and clothing
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 由檯燈、壁燈、床頭燈等局部暖光源落在人物身上，形成明確暖色光區與衰減。

光線表現 (Light Style).en: minimal nocturnal subject rim light, faint cool edge tracing along face hair shoulders and body outline, mostly dark subject mass
光線表現 (Light Style).desc: 主體大多留在暗部，只在臉側、肩線、髮絲或肢體邊緣保留很少量夜間微光。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: none
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 不指定成像風格，讓模型自行決定畫面質感與成像方式。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Polaroid instant-film rendering, faded pastel color response, low contrast curve, soft chemical development texture, subtle edge softness, classic white border
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 模擬拍立得即時成像的低對比、淡粉 pastel 色彩、柔和邊緣與化學顯影質地，白色相紙邊框作為成像特徵保留。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).zh: 柯達 Portra 暖膚底片
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Kodak Portra film rendering, warm accurate skin-tone response, fine film grain, broad highlight latitude, smooth contrast curve, gentle analog color density
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 強調 Portra 系列的暖膚色反應、細緻底片顆粒、寬亮部容忍度與柔順對比曲線，整體色彩濃度溫和自然。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).zh: 富士 Superia 青綠陰影底片
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Fujifilm Superia film rendering, cool-green shadow tint, punchy reds and greens, medium-high contrast curve, visible consumer-film grain, crisp analog color response
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 偏冷的陰影青綠色、較鮮明的紅綠色反應、中高對比與可見消費級底片顆粒，呈現清楚而有個性的類比色彩。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).zh: 富士 Classic Chrome 低彩編輯感
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Fujifilm Classic Chrome film simulation, muted color palette, subdued blues and reds, gentle contrast curve, dry editorial color response, restrained midtone density
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 低飽和、藍紅色受控、對比柔和且中間調密度較穩，呈現乾淨克制的雜誌式色彩反應。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).zh: 富士 Provia 清透明亮
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Fujifilm Provia film simulation, clean balanced color, transparent skin tones, bright natural contrast, crisp daylight-neutral rendering, smooth saturation response
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 比 Classic Chrome 更乾淨明亮，色彩平衡、膚色透明、對比清爽且飽和度過渡平順，偏向標準日光中性的富士色彩。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: premium monochrome rendering, black-and-white tonal response, rich grayscale separation, crisp micro-detail, deep blacks, luminous highlight control
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 不是一般黑白濾鏡，而是以細膩灰階層次、深黑位、清楚微細節與乾淨亮部控制形成高階黑白成像。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Leica-like monochrome rendering, rich grayscale separation, fine salt-and-pepper grain, deep blacks, crisp micro-detail, luminous skin highlights
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以 Leica Monochrom 類型的細鹽粒黑白、高灰階分離、深黑位、清楚微細節與乾淨膚色亮部為核心。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: vintage sharp rendering, rich micro-contrast, subtle warm highlights, clean 35mm color density, precise edge definition
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 帶有復古銳利感，重點是清楚邊緣、豐富微對比、微暖亮部與 35mm 色彩密度，而不是柔糊朦朧。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: warm digital portrait rendering, flattering skin-tone response, soft highlight roll-off, smooth color transitions, gentle contrast curve, polished color
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 強調暖膚色、柔順亮部 roll-off、平滑色彩過渡與穩定數位色彩，讓人物膚色更討喜。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: warm JPEG color rendering, bright warm white balance, pleasing skin tones, soft contrast, clean consumer color, smooth in-camera processing
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 偏向 JPEG 直出的明亮暖白平衡、舒服膚色、柔和對比與乾淨機內色彩處理，成像自然親和。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: cool-neutral digital rendering, crisp detail, cool white balance, strong clarity, realistic tonal depth, firm contrast curve, precise color separation
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 強調冷中性白平衡、清楚細節、較強 clarity、紮實階調深度與明確色彩分離。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: high-dynamic-range digital rendering, transparent shadows, crisp natural color, daylight-neutral contrast, clear highlight retention, high-resolution detail
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 強調高動態範圍、透明陰影、乾淨自然色、亮部保留與高解析細節，適合需要通透明亮成像的畫面。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: high-acutance snapshot rendering, snap-focus clarity, contrasty black levels, crisp APS-C-like color response, candid compact-camera texture
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 保留快照成像的 snap 清晰度、高銳利細節、偏硬黑位與小型相機質地，但不指定特定相機或場景。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: medium-format digital rendering, ultra-high resolution, broad dynamic range, smooth tonal transitions, refined color depth, organic large-sensor depth
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 模擬中片幅數位的高解析、寬動態範圍、平滑階調過渡、細緻色彩深度與大感光元件立體感。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: smartphone HDR JPEG rendering, automatic exposure balance, computational highlight recovery, crisp sharpening, noise-reduced shadows, clean modern phone color
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 模擬現代手機直出的 HDR 合成感、自動曝光、亮部追回、銳化、降噪陰影與乾淨手機色彩。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: VHS camcorder image degradation, analog tape noise, scanlines, color bleeding, chromatic aberration, low-resolution interlaced texture, tracking glitches
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 模擬老舊錄影帶的低解析、類比雜訊、掃描線、色彩滲色、色差與追蹤故障，用於明確的低畫質成像效果。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: early-2000s compact-digital rendering, on-camera flash glare, low-resolution CCD softness, narrow dynamic range, clipped highlights, crushed noisy shadows, magenta-green color cast, blocky JPEG artifacts
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以 2000 年代家用 CCD 小型數位相機的低清快照為核心，強化機頂閃光眩光、低解析 CCD 柔化、狹窄動態範圍、亮部剪切、暗部壓黑噪點、粉綠白平衡偏色與方塊狀 JPEG 壓縮痕跡。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).zh: 復古 CCD 晃動快照
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: retro CCD failure-snapshot rendering, heavy motion smear, soft low-pixel detail, blown unstable highlights, muddy chroma noise, purple edge fringing, banded gradients, low-end JPEG compression
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以早期 CCD 失手快照的強烈成像失真為核心，保留明顯手持晃動拖影、低像素柔化、亮部爆白不穩、髒色彩噪點、邊緣紫邊、階調色帶斷裂與低階 JPEG 壓縮感。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: glossy Japanese portrait color grade, lifted midtones, creamy pale highlights, warm peach skin-tone protection, cyan-green shadows, vivid saturation, clean deep blacks
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以日系高完成度亮膚高彩為核心，中間調明顯上提，亮部偏奶白，膚色維持暖桃色保護，陰影帶青綠偏色，彩度鮮明但黑位仍保持乾淨深黑。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: transparent Japanese portrait color grade, airy low-contrast tonality, milky white highlights, pastel saturation, neutral-clean skin tones, delicate cool shadow tint
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以清透淡彩為核心，整體對比壓低、亮部偏奶白，彩度維持輕柔 pastel，膚色乾淨中性，陰影只帶很淡的冷色偏移。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: high-key Japanese portrait color grade, elevated exposure, creamy porcelain highlights, softened shadow floor, restrained saturation, protected dark-material density
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 比亮膚高彩更偏 high-key 高曝光，亮部走奶油瓷白，陰影底被柔化，整體飽和度較克制，但深色服裝與黑色材質仍保留足夠密度。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: neon-tinted Japanese portrait color grade, protected bright skin tones, cool cyan shadow bias, warm-magenta highlights, clean black levels, controlled luminous saturation
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以日系夜景亮膚霓虹為出發，但改寫為可跨場景套用的霓虹調色邏輯：膚色亮度受保護，陰影往冷青偏移，亮部混入暖洋紅霓虹感，黑位乾淨，彩色高光維持發亮但不失控。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: Japanese magazine color grade, vivid editorial saturation, polished highlight brightness, crisp micro-contrast, sharp edge definition, clean dense blacks, print-finish contrast
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 偏日系雜誌與偶像寫真的高完成度調色，保留鮮明但受控的高彩，亮部帶拋光感，微對比與邊線清楚，黑位緊實乾淨，整體接近高級印刷輸出的商業完成度。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: soft-tonal Japanese portrait color grade, luminous pale highlights, gentle bloom, lowered micro-contrast, airy contrast, pastel shadow softness
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 在亮膚基礎上加入柔霧式階調，亮部更柔更亮，伴隨輕微 bloom，微對比被壓低，整體對比更輕，陰影維持淡 pastel 柔軟感。

底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).en: neon cross-processed rendering, cyan-shifted cool tones, fluorescent primary-color saturation, posterized hard contrast, aggressively crushed black levels, cold porcelain highlights
底片與相機模擬 (Camera & Film Simulation).desc: 以跨沖式霓虹剪影為核心，整體色相向冷青藍偏移，紅黃等原色飽和被強力拉起，對比呈現海報式硬階調，中間調明顯壓暗、黑位積極收深，只保留冷白偏瓷感的亮部，整體形成強烈暗黑時裝感與數位化反轉片式成像。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: none
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 不指定光學效果，讓模型自行決定是否加入 flare、散景、柔焦、暗角等鏡頭特徵。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: heavy bokeh rendering, large out-of-focus highlight discs, aperture-shaped blur circles, pronounced background or foreground defocus highlights, optical blur balls
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 讓離焦高光形成大型光斑或光圈形狀，重點是散景形狀、尺寸與離焦高光的光學表現。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: swirly bokeh rendering, curved out-of-focus background highlights circling around the subject, vintage edge swirl, rotational peripheral blur character
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 背景散景在畫面邊緣形成旋繞流動感，重點是復古鏡頭式的周邊旋渦散景，而不是單純背景模糊。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: cat-eye bokeh rendering, oval edge highlights near the frame perimeter, lens-edge compression of blur discs, stretched off-axis background bokeh
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 畫面邊緣的散景光斑被拉成貓眼形橢圓，重點是離軸位置的鏡頭邊緣散景特徵。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: soap-bubble bokeh rendering, bright-rimmed blur circles, hollow-edged highlight discs, vintage triplet-lens background highlights, crisp bubble-like specular outlines
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 散景光斑邊緣有明亮輪廓、中央較空，形成像肥皂泡般的老鏡式高光圓圈。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: blurred foreground occlusion near the lens, out-of-focus shapes crossing one or more frame edges, meaningful partial frame coverage, thick near-field bokeh veil, clear opening toward the subject
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 鏡頭前方有失焦遮擋物形成近景模糊層，必須遮住部分畫面邊緣或局部視線，但保留能看清主體的開口與前景深度層次。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: foreground glass refraction near the lens, transparent distorted shapes crossing the frame, warped highlights, refracted subject-edge fragments, clear central viewing opening
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 像隔著玻璃、透明板或水晶邊緣拍攝，畫面前景帶透明折射扭曲，但仍保留能看見主體的清楚開口。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: prism refraction effect, split-image fragments, rainbow spectral streaks, duplicated edge reflections, crystalline light scattering near the frame
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 利用稜鏡或折射介質讓畫面邊緣出現分裂影像、彩虹色譜與晶體式反射碎片。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: starburst diffraction spikes on bright point lights, crisp radiating light rays, stopped-down aperture sparkle, sharp multi-point highlight stars
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 明亮點光源產生清楚放射狀星芒，重點是光圈繞射形成的多角星形高光。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: lens flare artifacts, internal lens reflections, veiling flare, ghosting shapes, streaking flare artifacts from a strong off-axis light source
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 強光進入鏡頭後造成內部反射、鬼影、光暈或條狀 flare，重點是鏡頭內部反射瑕疵。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).zh: 變形鏡頭光斑 Anamorphic Flare
光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: anamorphic lens flare artifacts, horizontal flare streaks, cylindrical lens reflection behavior, oval bokeh response, stretched optical highlights
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 變形鏡頭造成水平 flare、橢圓散景與被拉伸的高光反射，重點是柱面光學特徵。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: localized veiling flare, partial low-contrast haze around strong light entry, washed highlight patching, matte glare bloom without full-frame fog
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 局部強光進入鏡頭後形成一塊對比下降的霧面炫光區，像鍍膜失守或半片式 glare，而不是整張都起霧。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: analog film light leak artifacts, irregular edge exposure burns, translucent red-orange film-gate leaks, uneven accidental exposure streaks, frame-edge chemical light contamination
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 模擬底片或膠片匣漏光造成的不規則邊緣曝光、暖色光痕與局部化學感覆蓋。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: soft focus diffusion filter, lowered microcontrast, softened fine detail, gentle glow around high-contrast edges, preserved overall facial and subject structure
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 柔焦或擴散濾鏡降低微對比與細節銳度，在高反差邊緣產生柔和暈散，但仍保留主體結構。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: highlight bloom, halation around bright areas, local luminance bleeding, softened highlight edges, optical glow spill limited to high-value regions
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 高亮區域邊緣向外暈散，形成局部亮度溢出與 halation，重點是高光反應而非整體場景狀態。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: optical vignetting, darker frame corners, radial edge exposure falloff, center-weighted brightness, subtle lens shading toward the image perimeter
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 鏡頭邊緣進光量下降，畫面角落與邊緣呈現徑向變暗，中心亮度相對更集中。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: chromatic aberration, subtle RGB edge fringing, lateral color separation along high-contrast edges, minor lens dispersion artifact
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 高反差邊緣出現輕微 RGB 分離或彩色邊，重點是鏡片色散造成的光學瑕疵。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: peripheral edge blur, center sharpness with soft frame edges, field curvature softness, reduced corner resolution, lens falloff away from the image center
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 中心解析較高，越接近畫面邊緣越柔，模擬場曲、邊角解析下降或鏡頭周邊成像衰減。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: sharp center with smeared frame edges, radial edge stretching, directional peripheral blur, center-held subject clarity, warped outer image field
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 中央主體相對清楚，但畫面外圈有明顯方向性拉抹與扭曲，像低品質濾鏡或實驗鏡片造成的邊緣拖拽感。

光學效果 (Optical Effects).en: lens-only mist-filter haze, veiling glare, lowered global contrast, softened black levels, diffused highlight edges, optical diffusion layer
光學效果 (Optical Effects).desc: 像鏡頭前加了 mist 濾鏡或產生遮蔽眩光，使整體對比下降、黑位抬高與高光邊緣變柔；重點是鏡頭濾鏡感，不是場景天氣。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: seated pose hugging knees, compact self-contained posture, quiet relaxed body language
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 雙手或手臂自然抱膝，身體線條較集中而收斂。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: side reclined pose, body gently extended, relaxed low posture, soft flowing body line
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 身體側向延展，整體姿勢放鬆，適合柔和低姿態畫面。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: relaxed supine pose, lying on her back facing upward, one arm raised loosely above the head, the other resting casually beside the body, legs bent naturally in a soft asymmetrical way, upright non-inverted body orientation
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 正面朝上的舒服仰躺姿勢，手腳自然不對稱，避免頭下腳上的倒置構圖。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: reclined pose supported by one arm, lifted upper body, natural relaxed asymmetry
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 以單手或手肘支撐上半身，讓姿勢更有層次。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: slightly curled relaxed low pose, soft compact body line, intimate restful posture
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 身體略微收起，帶休息感、柔軟感與生活感。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: low prone pose, upper body close to the surface, relaxed intimate body line
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 上半身接近低平面，身體趴臥放鬆，適合低姿態構圖。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: elongated side-lying pose, extended body line, calm graceful low posture
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 身體橫向延展，線條完整，適合全身構圖。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: natural squatting pose, relaxed low posture, balanced body weight, casual grounded body language
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 身體自然下蹲，重心穩定不誇張。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: one-knee squat pose, asymmetrical low stance, stable grounded posture, natural visual rhythm
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 一膝較低、一膝支撐，姿態更有層次。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: squatting pose with one hand resting on knee, relaxed low stance, casual confident body language
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 下蹲時手自然扶在膝上，姿態清楚且穩定。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: light stepping motion, subtle body movement, natural transitional pose, candid rhythm
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 像正在慢慢走動或移動重心，避免人物太靜止。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: adjusting hair while moving, candid grooming gesture, natural in-between motion
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 手正在整理頭髮，像被捕捉到的自然瞬間。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: adjusting clothing hem, subtle styling gesture, candid everyday movement
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 手碰觸衣物或衣襬，帶自然日常的整理動作。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: hand lifting toward shoulder or neck, soft adjustment gesture, delicate natural motion
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 手靠近肩頸、鎖骨或耳側，適合細膩近景人物狀態。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: body turning in motion, torso rotating naturally, transitional pose with subtle tension
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 身體正在轉向或回身，增加動勢與不僵硬的過渡感。

姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).en: just-stopped movement pose, stillness after motion, balanced transitional body language
姿勢與肢體語言 (Pose & Body Language).desc: 像剛停下腳步的狀態，保留動作後的穩定停格。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: none
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 不指定特殊動作，保留一般姿勢動作系統。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: applying lipstick with the lipstick bullet pressed to the lips, visible hand-to-mouth contact, slight lip pressure, polished beauty touch-up portrait moment
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以口紅膏體實際接觸嘴唇的補妝瞬間為主，重點是嘴唇因接觸與施力而出現些微擠壓變形，帶明確的美容行為與近距離寫真感。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: messy lipstick application with the lipstick bullet touching the mouth, color smudged beyond the lip line, visible hand contact, imperfect beauty close-up moment
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以手持口紅實際往嘴唇塗抹、並且塗出唇線外的失手感或刻意塗歪效果為主，強調口紅道具清楚可見、顏色外溢、邊緣暈開與不完美的近距離美容特寫。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: holding a clear plastic takeaway cup of iced coffee near the lips mid-sip, visible straw or cup rim, relaxed everyday cafe portrait moment
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以手持透明外帶塑膠杯裝的冰咖啡準備啜飲或剛啜飲的瞬間為主，重點是杯身清楚可見、帶生活感與刻意擺拍兼具的日常咖啡情境。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: biting a colorful whirly pop swirl lollipop at the lips, candy prop clearly visible, playful portrait interaction with crisp mouth contact
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以咬著波板糖的瞬間為主，讓糖果本身成為明確視覺道具，帶一點俏皮與角色感，同時保留乾淨直接的人像構圖。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: holding a cigarette between the fingers near the lips, faint smoke close to the face, controlled cinematic portrait gesture
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以手指夾著香菸靠近嘴邊的瞬間為主，煙霧只作為輕量氛圍，不讓道具過度主導畫面。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: one hand pulling up a stocking on one leg, clear hosiery adjustment, visible hand-leg contact, fashion dressing gesture
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以單手拉起一側絲襪的穿戴整理動作為主，需要至少能清楚看到腿部與手部互動。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: standing forward lean from the waist, both hands gripping the front waistband or belt loops, elbows angled outward, shoulders forward, energetic close-interaction pose
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以上半身從腰部向鏡頭前傾、雙手抓住褲腰兩側或皮帶環為主，手肘向外、肩膀前壓、臀部微微向後，帶有靠近鏡頭的互動感；不綁定特定場景。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: side-saddle seated pose with both legs folded to one side, one hand planted behind the body, torso leaning back, relaxed asymmetrical support
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以側坐、雙腿折向一側、一手在身後或身側支撐身體的動作為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: seated pose with knees drawn close to the chest, elbows near the knees, both hands cupping the cheeks, intimate front-facing seated posture
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以膝蓋靠近胸前、雙手托腮、手肘靠近膝蓋的正面坐姿為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: lying on her back, arms bent beside the shoulders, hands softly lifted near the head, calm open upper-body resting pose
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以仰躺、雙手在肩膀或頭部兩側自然微抬的休息動作為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: kneeling seated pose with the body turned away, looking back over the shoulder, one hand touching the hair near the head, over-the-shoulder portrait action
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以跪坐或坐在小腿上的回眸姿態為主，身體背向鏡頭、一手抬起觸碰頭髮，不綁定特定場景或道具。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: pulling the top partially off one shoulder while adjusting the fabric, one hand holding the neckline, fashion styling gesture
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以把上衣肩線拉下一點並整理布料的造型瞬間為主，偏服裝 styling 動作而不是完整脫衣事件。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).zh: 隨性癱坐在雕花單人絨布沙發上
特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: lounging in a casual sprawl on an ornate carved velvet armchair, body slumped or draped across the seat, editorial location-contrast portrait action
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以被刻意放進場景裡的雕花單人絨布沙發為核心，整體姿勢偏慵懶隨性，允許人物自然癱坐、倚靠、斜躺或半躺在沙發上，重點是鬆弛而帶企劃感的擺拍狀態。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: lying on her stomach with upper body propped on forearms, holding a cell phone in one hand, legs bent upward with crossed ankles, casual lounging action
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以俯臥趴姿滑手機的放鬆瞬間為主，上半身由前臂支撐，雙腿抬起交疊，適合帶一點私密感的休閒企劃。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: standing with one side of the upper body resting against a wall, weight shifted naturally, relaxed asymmetrical wall-lean pose
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以單側肩膀或上臂輕靠牆面的站姿為主，重點是身體重心偏向一側、姿態自然不對稱，帶有輕鬆克制的倚牆感。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: sitting on the floor with the full back resting against a wall, both legs extended forward, relaxed grounded wall-seated pose
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以坐在地面、整個背部貼靠牆面、雙腿向前自然伸直的姿態為主，整體偏安靜、放空、帶一點倦懶感的靠牆坐姿。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: standing with the full back leaning against a wall, body angled into a controlled backward recline, legs supporting the weight, arms relaxed at the sides
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以整個背部貼靠牆面、身體向後斜仰並由雙腿站立支撐的姿態為主，重點是像被牆面承接住的懸浮後仰感，以及垂直牆面與身體斜線形成的特殊張力。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: reclining on the floor with upper body leaned against a wall, both legs lifted upward in staggered angles, raised-leg silhouette with compressed space tension
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以靠牆仰躺、上半身後靠、雙腿向上抬起並交錯延伸的姿態為主，重點在腿部形成的高低交錯線條與帶點壓縮空間感的擺拍張力。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: reclining on one side with upper body supported by one arm, legs stretched forward, one knee slightly bent, elongated relaxed body line
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以側身斜躺並延伸腿部的姿態為主，強調修長線條與舞者般的舒展感，需要清楚看到整體肢體延伸。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: kneeling on both knees on a seat or platform, upper body leaning forward, forearms folded across a tall backrest, supported stretched-torso pose
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以雙膝跪在座面或平台上、上半身前傾並把前臂交疊倚靠在高處支撐物上的姿態為主，重點是前傾延伸的上半身、微微後提的臀部與被支撐住的放鬆倚靠感。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: on all fours with both hands and knees on the ground, torso leaning forward, arms extended, back arched, hips lifted, head angled downward
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以四足跪姿前傾的誇張肢體張力為主，背部拱起、臀部抬高，需要大範圍肢體可見才能成立。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: lying prone with her torso propped on a large pillow, turning over the shoulder, hips lifted in an arched posture, knees grounded behind
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以俯臥抱枕並回眸的姿勢為主，強調靠枕、拱起的身體曲線與帶點私密感的回望瞬間。

特殊動作 (Special Actions).en: kneeling with legs spread and feet tucked under, torso sitting back toward the heels, palms planted between the thighs, head dipped with upward eyes
特殊動作 (Special Actions).desc: 以分腿跪坐、雙手撐地、低頭抬眼的誇張肢體張力為主，重點在前挺胸口與壓低頭部形成的視線反差，需要清楚看到完整跪姿。

通用人體防護.en: deformed, bad anatomy, disfigured, poorly drawn face, mutation, mutated, ugly, disgusting
通用人體防護.desc: 最基礎且必備的防護牆。防止 AI 隨機生成嚴重扭曲的人體結構或面部器官。

通用人體防護.en: bad hands, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, poorly drawn hands, twisted fingers, fused fingers
通用人體防護.desc: 針對 AI 最弱的「手部細節」加強防護，避免出現六根手指、手指融合或不合邏輯的折疊。

通用人體防護.en: missing legs, extra legs, bad feet, twisted legs, broken bone, unnatural posture, disconnected limbs
通用人體防護.desc: 避免站姿或坐姿時，腿部憑空消失、多出一條腿，或是關節朝反方向彎折。

通用人體防護.en: long neck, detached head, weird jaw, out of frame head, multiple heads, elongated face
通用人體防護.desc: 避免頭部與身體脫節、脖子異常拉長如蛇，或是同一個畫面上出現多顆頭顱。

通用人體防護.en: cross-eyed, asymmetric eyes, weird eyes, missing nose, bad teeth, malformed lips, unrealistic facial proportions
通用人體防護.desc: 強制五官對稱，避免鬥雞眼、大小眼，或是張嘴時出現恐怖的牙齒結構。

畫質與渲染防護.en: worst quality, low quality, normal quality, lowres, blurry, out of focus, jpeg artifacts, pixelated
畫質與渲染防護.desc: 強制模型提升輸出解析度與清晰度，避免出現像素化、邊緣模糊或壓縮產生的鋸齒亮斑。

畫質與渲染防護.en: watermark, text, signature, logo, username, typography, letters, stamped
畫質與渲染防護.desc: 避免 AI 模仿圖庫網站（如 Getty Images）而在畫面中隨機生成無意義的浮水印、簽名或亂碼文字。

畫質與渲染防護.en: cropped, out of frame, cut off, border, frame, white margins
畫質與渲染防護.desc: 確保人物或主體不會被不自然的裁切在畫布邊緣，同時避免生成相框狀的邊框（除非刻意要求拍立得）。

風格與寫實度防護.en: 3D render, CGI, octane render, unreal engine, plastic skin, smooth skin, doll, toy, artificial
風格與寫實度防護.desc: 為了維持「寫實攝影」的質感，必須剔除任何帶有塑膠感、假人感或 3D 動畫引擎渲染效果的特徵。

風格與寫實度防護.en: illustration, painting, drawing, sketch, anime, cartoon, monochrome painting, vector art, flat color
風格與寫實度防護.desc: 防止生圖變成二次元動漫、手繪素描或油畫，維護真實物理世界的光影與三維立體感。

風格與寫實度防護.en: oversaturated, overly bright, bleached, artificial lighting, overly smooth face, heavy makeup filter
風格與寫實度防護.desc: 避免畫面呈現出如「美圖秀秀」般極端不自然的美顏濾鏡感、死白膚色或刺眼的過高飽和度。

場景與物理防護.en: floating objects, defying gravity, floating limbs, flying, unconnected items, messy physics
場景與物理防護.desc: 確保畫面中（特別是室內場景）的物件符合重力邏輯，避免杯子、椅子等物品懸浮在半空中。

場景與物理防護.en: messy background, cluttered space, distracting background elements, messy room, trash
場景與物理防護.desc: 適用於需要凸顯人物的棚拍或商業攝影，強制清除背景中多餘的雜物與干擾視線的髒亂。

場景與物理防護.en: bad perspective, warped architecture, distorted buildings, twisted walls, physically impossible architecture
場景與物理防護.desc: 特別針對都市街景或室內空間，防止建築物、牆壁與背景街道出現扭曲變形，如全面啟動般的空間坍塌。

服裝與材質防護.en: clothing clipping through skin, missing clothes, floating clothes, inconsistent fashion, merging fabrics
服裝與材質防護.desc: 避免皮膚與衣物邊緣融合、衣服懸空，或是上衣跟下裝的材質不可理喻地縫合在一起。

特定主題防護 (依需求加入).zh: 自然派防護 (剔除不自然元素)
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).en: artificial light, studio light, flash, posed, fake, unnatural colors, synthetic nature
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).desc: 當「AI 攝影師」選擇了自然或戶外主題時加入。避免自然環境中出現明顯的棚內反光板或人造光的斧鑿痕跡。

特定主題防護 (依需求加入).zh: 黑暗恐怖防護 (維持唯美)
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).en: horror, scary, gore, blood, creepy, zombie, grotesque, macabre, disturbing
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).desc: 除非主題為 BDSM 或廢墟，否則即使在暗調光影下，也必須加入此組以防止畫面過度恐怖或出現血腥驚悚元素。

特定主題防護 (依需求加入).zh: 過度暴露防護 (維持時尚)
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).en: nsfw, explicit, nude, naked, highly revealing, pornographic, lewd
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).desc: 確保大尺度內衣或泳裝攝影僅停留在「性感與時尚」的邊界，防止生成被審查的成人限制級畫面。

特定主題防護 (依需求加入).zh: 現代物品防護 (針對復古主題)
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).en: modern technology, smartphone, modern cars, led lights, contemporary clothing, digital screen
特定主題防護 (依需求加入).desc: 拍攝維多利亞、巴洛克或古典主題時必加。防止畫面上出現手機、現代汽車或電子螢幕這類破壞時代感的物品。
